name: Castro Marim
mandate: PrompTugal.news Castro Marim: AI and technology in Castro Marim, a salt-pan and Guadiana border town where the AI sits in its council's planning office and its salt works, and what reaches Castro Marim from the Algarve, Portugal and the world. Independent, and every fact sourced.

gravity.text: Castro Marim is a small municipality on the Guadiana, next to Spain, whose economy and identity rest on the traditional salt pans of the Sapal nature reserve, on tourism and on cross-border cooperation in the Eurocidade do Guadiana. Its AI is not a cluster but two concrete cases: a council modernising its planning office with a vendor's AI-ready software, and a salt-works family that built a software platform with an AI assistant for artisanal salt producers.

ai_news.title: A Castro Marim salt family launches SalOS, a platform with an AI assistant for salt makers
ai_news.summary: A platform built from the work of a Castro Marim salt works manages harvest, lab, stock, sales and traceability for artisanal sea salt on a phone or computer. Press coverage says it includes a digital assistant for operational questions and a tool for sluice and salinity management. Free trial for producers.
ai_news.ai_path: A local company ships a software product with an AI assistant (Marnoto AI, per the press). The product's own Spanish page lists the modules but does not mention the AI assistant, so the AI claim rests on press coverage.

ai_news.title: SalOS is also covered as a traceability platform ready for the EU Digital Product Passport
ai_news.summary: The same launch, reported on 7 July: one program for harvest, laboratory, quality, warehouse, sales and invoicing, a QR code on each pack, and a digital assistant for operational questions. The article does not name the company behind the software.
ai_news.ai_path: The platform has an AI digital assistant and a salinity and sluice support tool, built in Castro Marim.

ai_news.title: Castro Marim's council puts AI into its planning office roadmap with Mind
ai_news.summary: At the council's municipal day session on 24 June 2026 the software company Mind presented a phased digital urban planning project. The document system is being introduced now. A later phase adds an online planning service with AI that helps people complete requests before they reach council staff. The dates are the vendor's own plan.
ai_news.ai_path: A Portuguese council plans a public service that uses AI, and its current step is the software that prepares for it. Source is the vendor, not independent press.

ai_news.title: Eurocidade do Guadiana tourism pitch made with AI avatars of three mayors, Castro Marim's among them
ai_news.summary: In January 2024 Ayamonte presented a pilot AI video that recreates the mayors of Ayamonte, Vila Real de Santo António and Castro Marim promoting the cross-border area in several languages at once. Older than our usual window but the only cross-border AI project that includes Castro Marim.
ai_news.ai_path: Three councils, Castro Marim's included, used generative AI to promote tourism. The page is partly garbled, so details are limited.

ai_map.name: SalOS
ai_map.what: Traceability and operations platform for artisanal salt producers, born inside the Sapal de Castro Marim reserve, with a free 30 day trial. Press describes a digital assistant and a salinity and sluice support tool.
ai_map.ai_path: Ships a product with an AI assistant, per press.

ai_map.name: Câmara Municipal de Castro Marim
ai_map.what: The council is introducing a digital planning document system and, per the vendor, plans an online planning service with AI. Its own urbanismo page lists a GeoPortal and online services and does not mention AI.
ai_map.ai_path: A public body adopting AI-enabled software for citizen services (planned).

ai_map.name: Mind (ePaper)
ai_map.what: Portuguese software vendor whose ePaper urban planning system is going into Castro Marim. It also markets an AI agent, Agente ePaper IA, that answers planning questions in natural language, reported on its own news page on 13 October 2026.
ai_map.ai_path: Vendor of an AI agent product and of the AI-ready software the council is adopting. Not based in Castro Marim as far as we saw, listed because it supplies the town.

ai_map.name: Eurocidade do Guadiana (Ayamonte, Vila Real de Santo António, Castro Marim)
ai_map.what: Cross-border grouping of three councils that presented a pilot AI avatar video for tourism in January 2024, led by Ayamonte. Castro Marim's council president took part.
ai_map.ai_path: A grouping that includes Castro Marim used generative AI for tourism promotion.

gaps: AI news is thin: in a search of the council's news pages (September to November 2026) we found no headline about AI or technology. The two local AI stories both come from July 2026 and one rests on the vendor's own page.

SalOS's press coverage (Barlavento, Jornal Económico) reports an AI assistant (Marnoto AI) and a water support tool, but neither salos.net's Spanish page nor its main page mentions AI (they list automatic DOP validation and FIFO allocation). We should ask the company before treating the AI claim as settled.

We could not open Jornal do Algarve (403), Postal do Algarve (bot challenge) or Sul Informação (403), so their Castro Marim coverage is missing. Search results point to Sul Informação items we have not read: a robotics and programming holiday camp run by a youth association in August 2026, and an Algarve dementia congress held in Castro Marim on 12 and 13 November 2026 with an AI and neurostimulation session. Both are leads, not facts, until a page we can open confirms them.
The council site has no RSS or Atom feed that we could find, so Castro Marim cannot be followed automatically yet.
University of Algarve work in the salt pans (CCMAR's SAL+) and CRIA's 2022 blue innovation contest are real local innovation but we saw no AI in them, so they stay out of the map for now.
No AI or tech events found in Castro Marim: the council agenda lists only cultural, sporting and local events. No Algarve Evolution member or startup base found in the municipality yet.
We have not found a data centre, an AI research group, an AI training course or an AI investor in the municipality.

The council's incubation space (Edifício Multifuncional de Empresas) describes itself as for innovative, scalable projects but its page mentions no digital, tech or AI focus, and we found no company in it with an AI link.

voice.lede: Cá em Castro Marim the salt dries in the sun and the AI, ó pá, still has to be asked to come up from the car park.
voice.mandate: PrompTugal.news Castro Marim: we are the last town before Espanha, so we watch the AI coming over the Guadiana like a flamingo watching the tide. Salt pans, a council with a clever planning office and a family that taught a salt works to talk back. What comes from the Algarve, Portugal and the world gets weighed here like flor de sal, by the gram. Independent, and every fact has its source.
voice.gravity: Small town, big sky, lots of salt. Our money is in the pans of the Sapal, in visitors and in neighbourly dealings with Espanha across the river. Our AI, to be fair, is not a crowd, it is two cases: the Câmara tidying its planning papers with software that will one day answer citizens, and a salt family that built an app so clever it has an assistant.
